how: GitHub Copilot Free was used for inline code completion and to help troubleshoot syntax and lint errors. ChatGPT Free was used as a coding assistant to reason through the Model A implementation, review peer feedback, and finalize the T5 code and report wording.
why: These tools were used to speed up repetitive coding work, identify syntax or implementation issues, and provide a second check on the model-training logic and report wording while the final technical decisions remained with me.
footer_note: Supporting non-AI tool: Marimo Web Notebook was used to enter and format reader-facing text, including callouts and Markdown content. It was used as the notebook authoring environment, not as an AI-generation tool.
